requirements_slice.system_goal: Determine whether FEAT-NOTIFY-CHECK can implement Day-slice-only execute=true defaulting, and stop on contract mismatch if the current repo lacks a Day-owned Notify-check intake/default/dispatch surface.

in_scope.item: Existing Day dev runtime indicator binding scan
Frontend repository probe for Day-owned Notify-check intake/default/dispatch files
Feature-local GRACE docs and packet-local evidence for the contract verdict

out_of_scope.item: Inventing a new Day Notify-check product surface without a separate architect decision

use_case.summary: Determine whether the current Day frontend has an implementable Notify-check intake/default/dispatch path.
use_case.scenario: Worker binds the adjacent Day runtime-indicator files and records that they are only adjacent evidence unless a concrete Notify-check surface is also present.
If no Day-owned Notify-check intake/default/dispatch file exists, worker records contract-mismatch-no-day-notify-surface and does not edit adjacent runtime-indicator files to simulate the feature.

business_invariants.invariant: Original intended behavior remains execute=true by default for a Day Notify-check intake, with explicit execute=false preserved, but it is not implementable in the current repo without a concrete Day Notify-check surface.
Day runtime-indicator disclosure evidence cannot be treated as Notify-check acceptance proof.
No backend, Prefect, or non-Day frontend scope may be introduced by this feature packet.
If the business still requires Notify check, the next architect decision must either create a new Day Notify-check surface or reslice the request away from the nonexistent surface.

expected_failure_handling.item: If the Notify-check surface is absent, stop with contract-mismatch-no-day-notify-surface instead of widening scope.
If a shared helper is discovered, stop for architect reslicing unless the helper can be proven Day-owned.
If runtime-indicator-only tests pass, record them as adjacent smoke evidence only.

known_defects.defect: DEFECT-DAY-NOTIFY-CHECK-SURFACE-MISSING: the current repo scan finds the Day runtime-indicator surface but no Day-owned frontend Notify-check intake/default/dispatch path.

success_criteria.criterion: Concrete Day runtime-indicator bindings are recorded.
The absence or presence of Day Notify-check intake/default/dispatch bindings is recorded with exact command evidence.
If the bindings are absent, W01 exits as contract mismatch and does not claim implementation success.
Packet-local evidence is sufficient for reviewer and architect to decide without canonical Today/Week observability closeout.
